per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI must adhere to corporate standards for look, feel, and accessibility.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must respond to user interactions within five seconds for routine screen-to-screen transitions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must maintain data integrity by tracing all authoritative data back to the canonical sources (Statement Database and Cardmember Information Database).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must not make direct changes to account balances; all adjustments must be processed through the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System. This will allow the Disputes application to request adjustments to cardmember and merchant's accounts. All adjustment requests must be sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must enforce role-based access control to restrict sensitive actions and data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must be available 24/7 with scheduled maintenance windows from 3:00 AM to 4:00 AM Eastern on weekdays and from 1:00 AM to 5:00 AM Eastern on Sundays.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must support up to 350 concurrent users without degradation in performance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must maintain an immutable audit log of all actions performed by representatives, including user ID, timestamp, previous and new values, and any associated documents or correspondence.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must comply with standard credit card dispute regulations, including timelines and notice requirements.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must conform to the legal requirements as specified by Regulation E and Regulation Z that govern credit card disputes processing.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must support data segregation and role-based views to ensure that external partners only see relevant data.

per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must pre-fill forms with data from the cardmember database to minimize the number of clicks and reduce repetitive tasks for representatives.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Information Database.
